description: A red clip filling from the left edge of the frame: `origin.x` is `left`, and one keyframe track takes `transform.scale.x` from a quarter to the whole on an ease_out. Frame 0 is red across the leftmost sixteen columns and black for the other forty-eight; by frame 16 the curve has it past three-quarters of the way across; frame 31 is the full raster. A pivot at the layer's centre instead puts every one of those bands in the middle of the frame with black on both sides, and a pivot the format ignored leaves frame 0 a quarter-width band in the middle too.
